content: It was discovered during first xray post op that the hip was displaced again; Jack will need another surgery Friday 10/2 to fix.

title: Cast/Brace

content: Jack's hip brace was left unlatched, this must have happened after Jack was sick and changed; the nurse never  reattached velcro across the base.
